items.criterion: The new `pdlc/` folder holds each file that init copies from the plugin, and the default design specs.
Each new job spec and capability spec is a stub in the form of its template.
The code maps split the code of wordfreq into clear boundaries, so that each later change knows the files that it owns.
`pdlc/config.md` has a chosen value in place of each placeholder, example, and hint.
The six check settings work for this Python `unittest` project, and the run proves that the all command skips acceptance files.
With `defaults`, the run asks the user nothing, and the final reply lists each decision that the run made for the user.
Without `defaults`, the run asks one question at a time, each with a recommended answer, about each decision that init leaves to the user.
Each answer of the user that differs from the proposal of the run shows in the pdlc files.
One commit on `main` records the new `pdlc/` folder, and the run leaves no other change.
The final reply tells the user how to start with pdlc.
